subtitles.zh: 人工智能在华盛顿罕见地获得两党共识。
subtitles.en: Artificial intelligence is drawing rare bipartisan agreement in Washington.

subtitles.zh: 两党议员，包括共和党人迈克·劳勒、恩特罗伊·唐宁，以及民主党人乔什·戈特海默和罗杰·克里希纳穆尔蒂，本周都在《权力平衡》节目中表达了基本相同的观点。
subtitles.en: Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle, including Republicans Mike Lawler, Entroy Downing, and Democrats Josh Gottheimer, and Roger Krishnamurthy, all made essentially the same case right here on Balance of Power this week.

subtitles.zh: 人工智能需要更多护栏。我们需要采取全政府的方式来处理这个问题。
subtitles.en: AI needs more guardrails. There needs to be a whole of government approach in how we handle this.

subtitles.zh: 这确实需要联邦政府制定标准。
subtitles.en: It does require the federal government putting in place standards.

subtitles.zh: 我们必须以明智、集中的方式来做这件事，设置良好的护栏来保护我们伟大国家的人民，并确保我们也能保持竞争力并胜出。
subtitles.en: We've got to do this in a smart, central way with good guardrails that protect the people of our great country, and ensure that we also can be competitive and win.

subtitles.zh: 我们是否应该讨论一些辅助措施，以确保我们控制住这一点，我认为这些是有益的对话。
subtitles.en: Should we be talking about something sideboard so that we are taking, you know, making sure that we have control of this, I think those are healthy conversations.

subtitles.zh: 不过，我希望我们能看到行动，因为现在比以往任何时候都更需要实现这一点。
subtitles.en: I'm hopeful, though, that we're going to see action, because now more than ever, we have to make that occur.

subtitles.zh: 而且，我认为坦率地说，这在11月将是一个投票议题。
subtitles.en: And, you know, I think this is on the ballot quite frankly for November.

subtitles.zh: 不同的政党，不同的地区，但越来越有相同的担忧。
subtitles.en: Different parties, different parts of the country, but increasingly the same concern.

subtitles.zh: 不仅是国会，宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗，一位可能的2028年竞争者，今天也加入了他推动更严格人工智能护栏的行列。
subtitles.en: And it's not just Congress, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro, a possible 2028 contender, added to his push for tougher AI guardrails today.

subtitles.zh: 彭博社的马里奥·帕克现在加入我们，带来本周的深度解读。
subtitles.en: Bloomberg's Mario Parker is joining us now for more in this week's debrief.

subtitles.zh: 马里奥，当各派议员都发出同样的声音时，说明政治风向已经转变。
subtitles.en: So, Mario, when you have lawmakers of all stripes saying the same thing, it tells you the political wind has shifted.

subtitles.zh: 而且转变相当快。我们该怎么看？确实如此。
subtitles.en: And it's done so pretty quickly. What should we make of this? Yes, absolutely.

subtitles.zh: 人工智能在华盛顿罕见地获得两党共识。
subtitles.en: Artificial intelligence is drawing rare bipartisan agreement in Washington.

subtitles.zh: 两党议员，包括共和党人迈克·劳勒、恩特罗伊·唐宁，以及民主党人乔什·戈特海默和罗杰·克里希纳穆尔蒂，本周都在《权力平衡》节目中表达了基本相同的观点。
subtitles.en: Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle, including Republicans Mike Lawler, Entroy Downing, and Democrats Josh Gottheimer, and Roger Krishnamurthy, all made essentially the same case right here on Balance of Power this week.

subtitles.zh: 人工智能需要更多护栏。我们需要采取全政府的方式来处理这个问题。
subtitles.en: AI needs more guardrails. There needs to be a whole of government approach in how we handle this.

subtitles.zh: 这确实需要联邦政府制定标准。
subtitles.en: It does require the federal government putting in place standards.

subtitles.zh: 我们必须以明智、集中的方式来做这件事，设置良好的护栏来保护我们伟大国家的人民，并确保我们也能保持竞争力并胜出。
subtitles.en: We've got to do this in a smart, central way with good guardrails that protect the people of our great country, and ensure that we also can be competitive and win.

subtitles.zh: 我们是否应该讨论一些辅助措施，以确保我们控制住这一点，我认为这些是有益的对话。
subtitles.en: Should we be talking about something sideboard so that we are taking, you know, making sure that we have control of this, I think those are healthy conversations.

subtitles.zh: 不过，我希望我们能看到行动，因为现在比以往任何时候都更需要实现这一点。
subtitles.en: I'm hopeful, though, that we're going to see action, because now more than ever, we have to make that occur.

subtitles.zh: 而且，我认为坦率地说，这在11月将是一个投票议题。
subtitles.en: And, you know, I think this is on the ballot quite frankly for November.

subtitles.zh: 不同的政党，不同的地区，但越来越有相同的担忧。
subtitles.en: Different parties, different parts of the country, but increasingly the same concern.

subtitles.zh: 不仅是国会，宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗，一位可能的2028年竞争者，今天也加入了他推动更严格人工智能护栏的行列。
subtitles.en: And it's not just Congress, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro, a possible 2028 contender, added to his push for tougher AI guardrails today.

subtitles.zh: 彭博社的马里奥·帕克现在加入我们，带来本周的深度解读。
subtitles.en: Bloomberg's Mario Parker is joining us now for more in this week's debrief.

subtitles.zh: 马里奥，当各派议员都发出同样的声音时，说明政治风向已经转变。
subtitles.en: So, Mario, when you have lawmakers of all stripes saying the same thing, it tells you the political wind has shifted.

subtitles.zh: 而且转变相当快。我们该怎么看？确实如此。
subtitles.en: And it's done so pretty quickly. What should we make of this? Yes, absolutely.
